title: A Twist of Jobim CD Lee Ritenour Herbie Hancock Al Jarreau Yellowjackets
conditionDescription: Pre-owned. Disc, jewel case and inserts show normal light wear consistent with age and storage. Please review photos for exact condition.
descriptionText:
A Twist of Jobim - Various Artists (i.e. music / PolyGram Records
314 533 693-2, 1997). Produced and arranged by Lee Ritenour.

Featuring Oleta Adams, John Beasley, Paulinho Da Costa, Melvin Davis,
El DeBarge, Cassio Duarte, Russell Ferrante, Dave Grusin,
Herbie Hancock, Al Jarreau, Eric Marienthal, Harvey Mason,
Christian McBride, Lee Ritenour, Steve Tavaglione, Ernie Watts and
The Yellowjackets.

Tracks include Water To Drink (Agua De Beber), Captain Bacardi, Dindi,
Waters Of March, Bonita, Stone Flower, Favela, Children's Games,
Lamento, Mojave and From Ipanema.

Disc, jewel case and pictured inserts are included. You will receive the exact CD pictured.
